subject: expression: lazy init `bufAllocator` in `baseBuiltinFunc` (#65244)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `baseBuiltinFunc.bufAllocator` is no longer eagerly allocated in constructors/clone paths and is now initialized inside `baseBuiltinFunc.isChildrenVectorized()` when all children are vectorized. Vectorized execution entrypoints in `pkg/expression` gate `VecEval*` calls behind `expr.Vectorized()` (for `ScalarFunction`, this calls `isChildrenVectorized()`), so `bufAllocator` is initialized before any vectorized builtin uses it. No remaining Blocker/High issues found; no later upstream changes indicate a follow-up fix in this area.
